basic_details.job_title: IISER Berhampur Post-Doctoral Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Berhampur (IISER Berhampur) Recruitment 2026 is for one temporary Post-Doctoral Research Fellow(PDRF) post. The post is under Prof. Gopi Nath Daptary in the Department of Physical Sciences and is paid from the Institute Fund. The tenure runs until 31 March 2027 from the date of joining, and the fellowship is paid as per Institute norms (GoI). Candidates need a Ph.D. in Experimental Condensed Matter Physics (awarded/submitted). Applications go by email to [email protected] and the last date is 5 November 2026.

important_dates.interview_date: To be informed later to shortlisted candidates

how_to_apply: Fill in the biodata form in the prescribed format. The notice says a copy of the form is attached.
Combine the biodata form and all supporting documents into a single PDF file smaller than 10 MB.
Write a brief note on your research expertise and include it in the application.
Send the PDF by email to [email protected] with this subject line: Application for the Position of PDRF against advt. no. IISERBPR/ADV/PDRF/PHY/2026/2 dated 26 Oct 2026

For any information, candidates can email the Principal Investigator, Prof. Gopi Nath Daptary, at [email protected]. The notice also gives the institute's contacts: [email protected] / [email protected] and Telephone: 0680 222 7776/728.
Biodata form in the prescribed format
A brief mention of the research expertise

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The qualification for the Post-Doctoral Research Fellow(PDRF) post, as the notice prints it under "Qualification as per guidelines", is: Ph.D. in Experimental Condensed Matter Physics (awarded/submitted) Candidates whose Ph.D. is already awarded and candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis can both apply. The candidate should be able to carry out experimental research in Materials Engineering, Thin film growth, Device fabrication and characterization. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IISER Berhampur PDRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IISER Berhampur has advertised 01 (One) Post-Doctoral Research Fellow(PDRF) post in the Dept. of Physical Sciences.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IISER Berhampur PDRF post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IISER Berhampur PDRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Ph.D. in Experimental Condensed Matter Physics (awarded/submitted). They should also be able to carry out experimental research in Materials Engineering, Thin film growth, Device fabrication and characterization.

faq.question: Q4. Can candidates who have only submitted their Ph.D. thesis apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice accepts a Ph.D. in Experimental Condensed Matter Physics that is either awarded or submitted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the IISER Berhampur PDRF post?
faq.answer: The fellowship/remuneration is as per Institute norms (GoI). The post is paid from the Institute Fund.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IISER Berhampur PDRF post?
faq.answer: Email the biodata form in the prescribed format, all supporting documents and a brief mention of your research expertise to [email protected]. Send everything as a single PDF smaller than 10 MB, by 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What subject line should I use in the application email?
faq.answer: Use this subject line: Application for the Position of PDRF against advt. no. IISERBPR/ADV/PDRF/PHY/2026/2 dated 26 Oct 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the IISER Berhampur PDRF post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed. The institute will give them the interview date later by Email/Phone.

faq.question: Q9. Will the IISER Berhampur PDRF interview be online?
faq.answer: Yes. The interview will be conducted online via Google Meet.

faq.question: Q10. Is the IISER Berhampur PDRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is temporary, and the tenure runs until 31 March 2027 from the date of joining.
